text.p: Invacare Corp said it provided notice to Healthdyne Technologies Inc of its intention to nominate seven director candidates at Healthdyne's upcoming but unscheduled annual meeting.
Invacare extended a $13 per share tender offer for Healthdyne though Healthdyne has rejected the offer as inadequate.

Invacare also said it submitted a set of corporate governance bylaw amendments for consideration at the annual meeting. The amendments would facilitate a board change and the closing of its tender offer, it said.
They would also prevent Healthdyne's board from manipulating by-laws and would allow for a special meeting to be called by shareholders owning 10 percent of the company's stock, Invacare said.
The amendments would also make the board eliminate the company's so-called pill provisions, it said.

The Invacare candidates nominated for election at the annual meeting were Nicholas DiCicco Jr, Donald Hastings, Jack Kahl, Ernest Peter Mansour, Jon Outcalt, James Allen Rutherford and Bill Sanford, the company said.
